must_present.label: Tall alpine peaks as height geometry, not gentle hills
Snow cubes on upper ridges/summits (not only a weather label)
Exposed rock/stone on lower slopes below the snowline
Meltwater stream leaving the massif into the wet corridor
Whitish high-altitude blizzard / wind-sheet particles on the snow-mountain peaks and upper alpine (not a forest-foothill decoration, not a legend string)
Placed high-altitude animals (goat/ibex class) on the peaks or upper rock

must_not_present.label: Dense pine/conifer forest replacing the alpine peaks (scattered treeline on lower slopes is allowed)
Lava / erupting volcano as the snow mountains
Jungle trees, cactus, or palms on the alpine massif
Desert dunes or sandstorm on the snow mountains
